overview:
CA-19 is a heavily Democratic district on California's central coast, with an 18-point Democratic partisan lean. Jimmy Panetta, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term from a commanding financial position: he has raised about $2.9 million and holds $5.1 million on hand. Republican challenger Peter Coe Verbica has raised roughly $85,000 and has under $8,000 remaining, and no outside groups are spending in the race on either side.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and resources. Prediction markets give Panetta about a 98 percent chance of winning. With the incumbent's advantages in money, name recognition, and district lean, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, and a genuinely competitive race would require an extraordinary development.
